scope: Main-agent editorial review of two existing generated excerpts; not blinded, not an independent expert rating or a new skill generation.

N-MD.location: Read PDF page 4, left column, first paragraph under Ligand-channel-facilitated mechanism; Fig. 2 caption on page 3.
N-MD.role: 模型身份、具体量、比较及局部解释的顺序；不能迁移其锂体系机制。

N-IF.location: Read PDF page 6, body below Fig. 4, interphase-analysis paragraph and corresponding caption.
N-IF.role: 测量/计算分工和观察与解释的相邻放置；不照搬来源因果强度。

A-IMG.location: Published PDF page 4, paragraph below Fig. 2 introducing LiCl comparison; continuation on right; Fig. 3 on page 5.
A-IMG.role: 对象、条件、时间序列及形貌对照；不能把来源原位条件移植给非原位XR-CT。

A-SPEC.location: Published PDF page 9, lower left, Raman/solvation paragraph associated with Fig. 5i,j; preceding context.
A-SPEC.role: 峰归属、定量比较与解释分层；不同谱带不可被虚设为同分母。

reviews.original: In the electrolyte series reported by Zhang et al., SE contained 4 m ZnOTf₂, DE contained 4 m ZnOTf₂ + 1 m ZnOAc₂, and HDE contained 2.8 m ZnOTf₂ + 0.7 m ZnOAc₂ with 30 wt% DMF relative to water, where m denotes molality.
reviews.reason: 三种配方与molality定义同句，读者需同时保存多个对象；按SE/DE与HDE分句。原数值和水质量基准均保留。

reviews.original: Deconvolution of the liquid-electrolyte FTIR O–H stretching bands at 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ showed a smaller strongly hydrogen-bonded contribution in DE and HDE than in SE, with the lowest contribution in HDE.
reviews.reason: 测量对象、谱段、拟合身份、对照和最小值齐全；句长来自必要比较，不必机械切短。

reviews.original: This trend supports a change in the water hydrogen-bond environment, although it does not directly quantify water activity or hydrogen-evolution rates.
reviews.reason: 将氢键环境与水活度/析氢测量区分，限制紧贴相应推断，不能为了流畅删除。

reviews.original: Anion-specific Raman fits provided complementary information on ion association.
reviews.reason: 只宣布Raman提供信息，下一句才给结果；可与下一句合并为直接描述拟合所得量。

reviews.original: The OTf⁻ SO₃ band in SE yielded an assigned contact ion pair (CIP) fraction of approximately 36.9%, whereas the acetate band in DE gave CIP and aggregate (AGG) fractions of approximately 64.5% and 12.4%, respectively.
reviews.reason: 两类阴离子及对应比例清楚；与前句合并时仍保留归属和不同统计对象。

reviews.original: These fractions concern different anions and spectral bands and cannot be subtracted to quantify an overall CIP increase.
reviews.reason: 不同谱带分母不可混算，是关键比较边界，不是空泛的谨慎话术。

reviews.original: Spectral complexity made accurate acetate fractions difficult to obtain for HDE.
reviews.reason: 明确HDE谱学定量缺口，不能用MD占比填成Raman实测。

reviews.original: Zn K-edge XANES edge shifts and changes in R-space EXAFS further supported rearrangement of the local Zn environment, although these features alone do not specify a unique coordination geometry.
reviews.reason: XANES edge重复；可用Shifts in the Zn K-edge XANES spectra，并明确EXAFS的变换域。几何不唯一的限制保留。

reviews.original: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provided a structural interpretation of these observations.
reviews.reason: 通用的structural interpretation没有具体信息，可让MD直接引出下一句的粒子分布趋势。

reviews.original: The solvent-separated ion-pair fraction decreased from 72.57% in SE to 50.41% in DE and 41.82% in HDE.
reviews.reason: 三体系间的下降方向及具体值清楚；并入MD句后仍标明模型身份。

reviews.original: Aggregation followed a different trend: the AGG fraction increased from 3.96% in SE to 33.07% in DE, then declined to 25.45% in HDE, while the CIP fraction increased from 16.52% in DE to 32.73% in HDE.
reviews.reason: 同句同时解释AGG非单调变化和CIP变化，按两个物种拆句，保留所有数字与对象。

reviews.original: HDE thus combined fewer solvent-separated pairs with more CIPs and fewer aggregates than DE.
reviews.reason: 已将原先模糊的重新分布写成HDE相对DE的具体差异，是清楚的局部综合。

reviews.original: These model populations are distinct from Raman peak fractions.
reviews.reason: 模型与Raman口径不同需保留；可随MD结果首次出现说明，不必在后面再作泛化提醒。

reviews.original: The reported mean DMF coordination number of 0.19 also indicates DMF participation in the simulated Zn²⁺ solvation shell.
reviews.reason: 0.19明确为平均配位数，模型中参与配位的表述有界，不应改成19%。

reviews.original: Together, the results support altered water interactions and Zn coordination as plausible contributors to improved reversibility, without uniquely establishing a mechanism of side-reaction suppression.
reviews.reason: 贡献与唯一机制分开得当；可与相邻限定统筹压缩，不能改成已经证明抑制副反应的唯一原因。

reviews.original: Because salt concentrations also changed, the comparisons do not isolate the DMF contribution.
reviews.reason: 盐浓度共同变化直接限制DMF单因果归属，必须可见。

reviews.original: The reported limitation under simultaneously very high current density and areal capacity further restricts extrapolation of this explanation.
reviews.reason: 同时很高电流密度和面容量的边界会改变外推；不得省去同时成立或补造阈值。

reviews.original: Pan et al. reported contact retention in micron-sized Si electrodes using an elastic electrolyte comprising an AM/DMAM copolymer and an NMA–LiFSI deep-eutectic mixture.
reviews.reason: 来源身份、材料和研究对象明确；这是已发表事实练习，第三人称不应作为风格错误。

reviews.original: Calibrated thin-film sensors measured built-in pressures of 546 kPa in coin cells and 52 kPa in pouch cells; operation without external loading therefore involved finite mechanical pressure.
reviews.reason: 压力值对应器件构型，明确无外加压力并非零压力，信息有用。

reviews.original: These measurements did not track pressure continuously during cycling.
reviews.reason: 连续监测与独立测压不同，若压缩应并入测量范围说明，而不能写成全程恒压已实测。

reviews.original: After 20 cycles, ex situ X-ray computed tomography (XR-CT) of recovered electrodes showed retained Si–electrolyte contact in the elastic system cycled at 546 kPa, whereas the Li₆PS₅Cl system cycled under 10 MPa exhibited pronounced cracks and voids.
reviews.reason: 虽较长，但单一平行比较包含20圈、非原位、两体系和两种压力，理解关系清楚。

reviews.original: The authors attributed bright streaks in the elastic sample to imaging artifacts.
reviews.reason: 将亮条纹作为作者判定的伪影，而非独立认证，避免形貌误读。

reviews.original: The pressure mismatch, unspecified terminal states of charge and absence of contact-area or porosity statistics restrict this comparison to qualitative structural evidence at the sampled states.
reviews.reason: 条件与定量缺口对应这次结构比较，属于结论所需限定。可与本段已有条件去重，但不能隐去。

reviews.original: Finite-element calculations support a mechanical interpretation of this contrast.
reviews.reason: 只说支持mechanical interpretation，具体预测在下一句；与下一句合并更直接。

reviews.original: With randomly distributed Si spheres and linear-elastic behavior assumed during lithiation-induced expansion, the model predicted lower, more uniform von Mises stresses in the elastic electrolyte, compared with stress concentrations in Li₆PS₅Cl.
reviews.reason: 模型假设、应力量、比较方向均有科学作用；并句时保留随机球、线弹性和膨胀情景。

reviews.original: This redistribution is consistent with reduced mechanical disruption and improved contact preservation.
reviews.reason: 从模拟应力过渡到接触解释，consistent with保持合理证据强度。

reviews.original: The proposed energy dissipation through rupture of noncovalent bonds remains an interpretation that XR-CT did not directly verify.
reviews.reason: 非共价键断裂不是XR-CT直接可见结果，限制具有针对性。

reviews.original: Differences in electrolyte formulation, electrode preparation and counter electrode (Li versus Li–In) further prevent the experimental comparison from isolating elasticity as the sole cause of improved structural integrity.
reviews.reason: 配方、工艺及对电极差异妨碍唯一弹性因果归属，不能当作语言冗余删除。

reviews.original: The electrochemical results place this interpretation within specific cell configurations.
reviews.reason: place this interpretation within specific cell configurations过于抽象；可前置S3.5中具体的接触—循环稳定性关系。

reviews.original: At 25 °C without additional pressure, Li||Si coin cells showed a reported capacity retention of 90.8% after 300 cycles in tests using 0.2 and 0.4 C.
reviews.reason: showed a reported capacity retention套叠；直接写reported capacity retention was即可，保留温度、倍率和圈数。

reviews.original: Separately, Si||LFP coin cells delivered 151.4 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.5 C, normalized to LFP mass, and showed a reported capacity retention of 98.3% after 100 cycles.
reviews.reason: 与上一句同类冗余，可统一为reported retention；LFP质量基准及独立全电池构型不能省略。

reviews.original: Their Si electrodes underwent one lithiation/delithiation cycle before full-cell assembly.
reviews.reason: 全电池装配前预循环关系影响性能理解，指代清楚。

reviews.original: These results are consistent with contact preservation contributing to cycling stability under the reported conditions.
reviews.reason: 实质关系有用；若移到段首，就删除此处重复表达，不能仅新增一条更漂亮的首句。

reviews.original: However, the 20-cycle images cannot establish uninterrupted contact throughout the longer cycling tests.
reviews.reason: 20圈结构证据与长循环性能之间的时间外推限制应保留。

limitations: Expression-comparison references support functional comparison, not the exercise scientific facts or every editorial judgment.
Two newly read style references do not define universal journal standards.
